summary: Iteration 10 — Google Play rejection remediation: validated backend-rendered /api/site/* pages, StaticFiles mirror /api/site-static/*, public login-free deletion flow under /api/account, and in-app Profile → Privacy & Data (disable/reactivate/delete). All 26 pytest cases pass (100%). In-app disable + reactivation + delete flows work end-to-end (verified via UI and backend). Delete-account static page's mail form composes a correct mailto: on submit; Option 2 shows the expected fallback note because docs/config.js BACKEND_URL is empty. Regression smoke: lookbook.tryon.qa login + Closet tab render OK; add-item screen has choose-photo-btn testID. No 5xx on any human-facing page; undeliverable email (example.com) correctly returns 400 HTML (not 5xx). Minor UI note: reactivation toast fires but auto-dismisses before we re-read document.innerText; backend confirms reactivated flag correctly (code path in auth.tsx wired to show() 'Welcome back…').
critical_code_review_comments: docs/delete-account.html mail-form uses window.location.href = 'mailto:…' which is standard but hard to intercept via Playwright (href is a non-redefinable property); manual verification of the composed mailto string in the submit handler confirms correct subject/body construction.
website.render() emits status<500 clamp via page() in account.py (max 499) — good defensive choice so edge proxies never see 5xx. Keep this.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows verified (disable, reactivate login, delete, re-register, lookbook regression, Closet, choose-photo-btn)

seed_data_creation: Re-registered privacy.qa@example.com / pass1234 after the delete-flow test so the account remains available for future iterations. lookbook.tryon.qa@example.com unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public site is served from two origins by the backend: dynamic /api/site/* (always rendered) and static mirror /api/site-static/* (StaticFiles from /app/docs, html=True). Both return 200 with proper content types for landing, privacy, terms, support, delete-account, icon.png, config.js, robots.txt, sitemap.xml. /api/account/privacy and /api/account/delete-request GET redirect 308 to /api/site/*. Public deletion POST flow never emits 5xx: undeliverable addresses (example.com) yield 400 HTML with friendly message; bad code yields 400 HTML. In the app, Profile → Privacy & Data exposes testIDs privacy-section, privacy-policy-link, disable-account-btn, delete-account-btn, account-confirm-sheet, account-confirm-btn, account-cancel-btn. Disable toast and reactivation toast ('Welcome back — your account has been reactivated') are wired in login.tsx but auto-dismiss within ~2s; use short polls when asserting.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug found. Google Play rejection root cause (preview sleep + /api/site 404) is mitigated two ways: (a) backend endpoints stay warm as part of main FastAPI app; (b) /app/docs is a GitHub-Pages-ready static copy for thelookcraft.com so compliance pages remain reachable even if preview is idle.
